notes: Exchange non-trading weekdays. NYSE holidays are computed from the exchange's published fixed rules (calendars.py); unscheduled closures are not modelled. TWSE lists come only from the official open-data holiday schedule (data.gov.tw dataset 11761, openapi.twse.com.tw/v1/holidaySchedule/holidaySchedule, 政府資料開放授權條款第1版). That feed publishes only the latest year; years without a recorded list are reported as unverified, never assumed holiday-free.
